name: ryu.pomodoro
description: Ask an agent to start a focus session and get a Pomodoro timer inline in chat. A small local MCP server exposes one tool (pomodoro.start) that takes focus, short-break and long-break lengths, how many focus rounds come before a long break, and an optional task label. The self-contained widget runs the countdown, cycles focus and break phases, and can play a short chime. It keeps its progress in widget state, so a reload restores the session. It makes no network requests and keeps no data outside the chat.

pomodoro.description: Pomodoro MCP server: the start tool and the ui://widget/pomodoro.html timer resource.
